content.text: Carpet is a simple and rewarding patience (solitaire) game. Four Aces form the foundations, twenty cards are laid out in a 5Ã—4 grid called the 'carpet,' and the remaining cards form a stock. The goal is to build all cards onto the foundations in suit from Ace to King.
Carpet is a traditional patience game of unknown origin. It belongs to the 'Calculation' family of solitaire games. The name comes from the 5Ã—4 grid of cards resembling a carpet pattern.
Standard 52-card pack. Remove the four Aces to form foundations. The remaining 48 cards are shuffled.
Standard deck of cards, playing surface
Remove four Aces and place them as foundations. Deal 20 cards face up in a 5Ã—4 grid (the 'carpet') with no overlaps. Remaining 28 cards form the stock (held in hand). Discard pile starts empty.
